Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7854); Satan, i.e. the devil:--Satan. Compare G4567.
BiblicalUsage: This word never occurs in the Greek New Testament. It is the Hebrew form of the name Satan, listed in the lexicon, but every Satan in the Greek text is the other form, Satanas — and every Satan in the King James Version translates that form, not this one.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that an honest word study says so plainly when a word has no verse, rather than inventing one for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
